description: One agent per file that matches a glob applies the same instruction, all on one branch; then one commit.

inputs.name: glob
inputs.label: Files
inputs.description: A glob, relative to the repository root.

inputs.name: instruction
inputs.label: Instruction
inputs.description: What to change in each file.

nodes.label: Commit
nodes.command:
set -e
git add -A
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
	echo 'Nothing changed.'
	exit 0
fi
git commit -m "per-file: {{glob}}" -m "{{instruction}}" -m "{{each.summary}}"
